mentions.name: Posturr
mentions.description: Posturr is a macOS app that monitors posture and blurs the screen when the user slouches. It uses unique reminder methods such as screen blurring and a colored border to help users check and correct their desk posture, and it was recently released on the Mac App Store.
mentions.problem: Bad posture while sitting at a desk, which the builder struggled with and wanted a way to check and correct.
mentions.source_excerpt: Posturr is a macOS app that blurs your screen when you slouch. I’ve always had bad posture at my desk, so I wanted to figure out a way to check myself.
